name: meu-bot
description: Bot de mesa pessoal: chat com Claude e execução aprovada na sua VM

scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/vendor.mjs && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/style.css src/renderer/quick-entry.html src/renderer/quick-entry.css src/renderer/picker.html src/renderer/picker.css src/renderer/relief.html src/renderer/relief.css dist/renderer/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run package && npm run fuses
